name: cipher-synthesis
example_construction: Reverse the 25 plaintext letters, then apply c = (5*p + 8) mod 26 to A-Z values. The key is not supplied to synthesis.
note: Synthetic conditional verification fixture for exact SMT cipher-model synthesis. Only six original-position plaintext letters are supplied. Identity layout is unsatisfiable under affine constraints; reverse followed by affine has a satisfying model. Alternate-value UNSAT queries prove the remaining plaintext letters within that tested model class. The SHA-256 checks the complete predicted A-Z vector, not a historical decipherment. Example parameters remain examples, model scope is finite and explicit, and claimed_plaintext remains null. This tool certificate has no cipher_name so it does not become a classical cipher router class.
